entries.wording: Your shipment is due to be delivered on Monday 02nd November 2026
entries.note: Any weekday and date: the row the page adds once it plans a delivery day, after the collection. The same day heads the page as its expected delivery.

entries.wording: Your shipment is due to be delivered to your ServicePoint on Wednesday 04th November 2026
entries.note: Any weekday and date: the delivery planned at a ServicePoint after a missed delivery, before the parcel reaches it.

entries.wording: Your shipment is at the delivery depot
Your shipment is at the delivery location
entries.note: Between the depot scan and the delivery round: not a delivery.

entries.wording: We're sorry but we haven't been able to deliver your shipment as our driver was unable to gain access to the delivery address

entries.note: Names no shipment. A delay on the way, after a missed delivery: the parcel moves on.

entries.wording: Your shipment is out for delivery

entries.note: Names no shipment. Its time is the signature's, under a delivered headline: the recipient collected the parcel.

entries.wording: We're sorry but your shipment was refused on delivery. Please contact your sender for further information
entries.note: The headline then says the shipment has been returned to the sender.

entries.wording: We're sorry but we haven't been able to locate the delivery address from the information provided by the sender.
entries.note: Names no attempt: the address the sender gave cannot be found, so delivery waits on a better one.

entries.wording: We're sorry but the delivery of your shipment has been delayed. We expect to deliver on the next working day
